$comment: OPT-IN: Codex gates plugin-bundled hooks behind [features].plugin_hooks = true.
Then re-install or reload the plugin. The hook adds Stop-event listener-resume:
- if the session is currently flagged as a listener (via `agent-bus mark-listening`)
- and the inbox poll returned a pending message OR the session is in listener mode,
- the hook returns decision=block with a 'continue inbox loop' prompt so Claude/Codex
naturally re-enters the inbox loop instead of returning control to the user.
- stop_hook_active guards against infinite loops within a single agent turn.
If you do not want this behavior, leave plugin_hooks disabled; agent-bus listener mode still works without it via the long-blocking inbox(wait_s=110) call alone.

hooks.description: If this session is in listener mode and has pending messages (or just an empty inbox while listening), return decision=block to keep the agent in the inbox loop. Safe no-op when not in listener mode or when agent-bus is not installed.
